title: Ali at the Shop
text:
Ali goes to the market on Saturday. He has a shopping list. The list has milk, eggs, bread and apples. He buys everything at the small shop.

Ali needs rice for dinner. The shop has rice, but it is very expensive today. Ali buys a small bag of rice. Then he goes home happy.

questions.text: What is on Ali's shopping list?
What does Ali buy for dinner?
Why does Ali go to the shop?
options: To buy food for his home

questions.text: How does Ali probably feel after shopping?

a set of words or items written one after another

paragraph_translations: Ali cumartesi günü markete gider. Onun bir alışveriş listesi vardır. Listede süt, yumurta, ekmek ve elma vardır. Her şeyi küçük dükkândan alır.
Ali akşam yemeği için pirince ihtiyaç duyar. Dükkânda pirinç vardır ama bugün çok pahalıdır. Ali küçük bir torba pirinç alır. Sonra mutlu bir şekilde eve döner.
